themes.name: Digital City Access
themes.rule: Proposals that improve access to municipal information, applications, service requests, or connectivity through online tools, public digital access, or assistance using those tools.

themes.name: Housing Affordability and Supply
themes.rule: Proposals that create, convert, regulate, upgrade, or make housing more affordable, including housing-market transparency.

themes.name: Local Jobs and Businesses
themes.rule: Proposals that support workers, career transitions, local hiring, entrepreneurship, or the operation of small businesses.

themes.name: Public Safety and Response
themes.rule: Proposals that prevent crime, improve perceived safety, or shorten emergency-response times through policing, surveillance, lighting, or emergency facilities.

themes.name: Transit and Street Mobility
themes.rule: Proposals that improve bus service, transit information or fares, cycling infrastructure, or street designs that make travel safer.

themes.name: Health and Care Access
themes.rule: Proposals that expand medical, mental-health, preventive-health, specialist-care, or in-home care services.

themes.name: Schools and Student Support
themes.rule: Proposals that improve schools, teaching, student meals, learning support, enrichment, or school-age transportation.

themes.name: Environmental Sustainability
themes.rule: Proposals that reduce pollution, waste, or resource use through monitoring, recycling, composting, clean energy, or restrictions on disposable materials.

themes.name: Parks and Neighborhood Recreation
themes.rule: Proposals that create or improve local green spaces, gardens, playgrounds, or dedicated outdoor recreation areas.

themes.name: Culture and Community Spaces
themes.rule: Proposals that expand cultural programming, arts access, libraries, festivals, concerts, museums, or public art.
